items.title: Unify member servicing on Salesforce Service Cloud + Agentforce
items.what_text: Scores 2.46 vs peer median 3.30 (−0.84, the largest competitive gap). Member servicing is fragmented across the contact center, a standalone KIT GenAI chatbot, and vendor digital-banking channels, with documented friction — $15 pay-by-phone fee, loan-payment UX, and no business mobile check deposit (, IS-001). Peers Sound CU (Posh AI omnichannel) and iQ CU (Cresta gen-AI contact center) have unified conversational servicing; KCU has not. Deploy Service Cloud on the EXISTING Financial Services Cloud foundation (already deployed, dedicated Admin+Developer, 'single pane of glass' goal) to consolidate case management, omnichannel routing, and a unified agent desktop; layer Agentforce for autonomous member self-service and agent assist. This converts the aspirational single-pane goal into operational member servicing. In Zennify's assessment Assisted Service Channels scores 1.5 out of 5, versus a typical 3.3 at comparable institutions [E-083].
